metadata.question: Does the water storage in Alabama decreases from 2003 to 2012?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use GRACE JPL Mascon TWS anomaly (NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON_CRI_GRID_RL06_V2), fallback to NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND. Filter to Alabama geometry (TIGER/2018/States) and dates 2003-01-01 to 2012-12-31.
2. Masking: No cloud masking needed. Use band 'lwe_thickness' (mm water equivalent). Validate spatial pixel count inside Alabama.
3. Logic: If collection empty -> C1. If valid pixel count 0 -> C2. Compute region-mean time series; if stats become NaN/null -> C3. Decide “Yes” if trend slope < 0 and 2010–2012 mean < 2003–2005 mean; else “No”.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Alabama'))
      .geometry();
    const fullStart = '2003-01-01';
    const fullEnd = '2012-12-31';
    const p1Start = '2003-01-01', p1End = '2005-12-31';
    const p2Start = '2010-01-01', p2End = '2012-12-31';
    const scale = 100000;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    const datasetIds = [
      'NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON_CRI_GRID_RL06_V2',
      'NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND'
    ];
    let usedId = null;
    let col = null;
    let totalSize = 0;
    for (const id of datasetIds) {
      const c = ee.ImageCollection(id).select(['lwe_thickness']).filterDate(fullStart, fullEnd);
      const sz = await getInfoAsync(c.size());
      if (sz > 0) {
        usedId = id;
        col = c;
        totalSize = sz;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!usedId) {
      console.log('GRACE Images (2003-2012): 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Valid pixel count check
    const first = ee.Image(col.first());
    const pxCount = await getInfoAsync(
      first.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('lwe_thickness')
    );
    if (!pxCount || pxCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}`);
      console.log(`GRACE Images (2003-2012): ${totalSize}`);
      console.log('Valid pixels in Alabama: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Build region-mean time series
    const colWithMean = col.map(function(img) {
      const mean = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('lwe_thickness');
      return img.set('region_mean', mean);
    }).filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['region_mean']));

    const validSize = await getInfoAsync(colWithMean.size());
    const times = await getInfoAsync(colWithMean.aggregate_array('system:time_start'));
    const vals = await getInfoAsync(colWithMean.aggregate_array('region_mean'));

    const msPerYear = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 365.25;
    const t0 = times && times.length ? times[0] : null;
    let xs = [], ys = [];
    if (t0 !== null) {
      for (let i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
        const v = vals[i];
        if (v === null || isNaN(v)) continue;
        xs.push((times[i] - t0) / msPerYear);
        ys.push(v);
      }
    }
    if (ys.length === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}`);
      console.log(`GRACE Images (2003-2012): ${totalSize} (valid means: 0)`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    function linreg(x, y) {
      const n = y.length;
      const mx = x.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n;
      const my = y.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n;
      let num = 0, den = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const dx = x[i] - mx;
        num += dx * (y[i] - my);
        den += dx * dx;
      }
      const slope = den === 0 ? NaN : num / den;
      const intercept = my - (isNaN(slope) ? 0 : slope) * mx;
      let ssRes = 0, ssTot = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const yh = intercept + (isNaN(slope) ? 0 : slope) * x[i];
        ssRes += Math.pow(y[i] - yh, 2);
        ssTot += Math.pow(y[i] - my, 2);
      }
      const r2 = ssTot === 0 ? 1 : 1 - ssRes / ssTot;
      return { slope, r2 };
    }
    const { slope, r2 } = linreg(xs, ys);
    if (!isFinite(slope) || isNaN(slope)) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}`);
      console.log(`GRACE Images (2003-2012): ${totalSize} (valid means: ${validSize})`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    async function periodMean(start, end) {
      const c = col.filterDate(start, end).map(function(img) {
        const mean = img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('lwe_thickness');
        return img.set('region_mean', mean);
      }).filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['region_mean']));
      const arr = await getInfoAsync(c.aggregate_array('region_mean'));
      let sum = 0, n = 0;
      if (arr) {
        for (const v of arr) {
          if (v !== null && !isNaN(v)) { sum += v; n += 1; }
        }
      }
      return { mean: n > 0 ? sum / n : null, n: n };
    }

    let p1 = await periodMean(p1Start, p1End);
    let p2 = await periodMean(p2Start, p2End);
    if (p1.n === 0 || p2.n === 0) {
      // Fallback to single years if 3-year windows are empty
      p1 = await periodMean('2003-01-01', '2003-12-31');
      p2 = await periodMean('2012-01-01', '2012-12-31');
      if (p1.n === 0 || p2.n === 0) {
        console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}`);
        console.log(`GRACE Images (2003-2012): ${totalSize} (valid means: ${validSize})`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }
    if (p1.mean === null || p2.mean === null || isNaN(p1.mean) || isNaN(p2.mean)) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}`);
      console.log(`GRACE Images (2003-2012): ${totalSize} (valid means: ${validSize})`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const diff = p2.mean - p1.mean;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}`);
    console.log(`GRACE Images (2003-2012): ${totalSize} (valid means: ${validSize})`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels in Alabama: ${pxCount} @100km`);
    console.log(`Mean TWSA 2003–2005: ${p1.mean.toFixed(2)} mm (n=${p1.n})`);
    console.log(`Mean TWSA 2010–2012: ${p2.mean.toFixed(2)} mm (n=${p2.n})`);
    console.log(`Difference (End - Start): ${diff.toFixed(2)} mm`);
    console.log(`Trend slope: ${slope.toFixed(2)} mm/yr, R2=${r2.toFixed(2)}`);

    const answer = (slope < 0 && diff < 0) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 200)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
